title: Plant hydraulic, hydromechanical and fungal stress-propagation qualification
claim_ceiling: This protocol does not validate plant drought predictions, prove a drought-signalling mechanism, establish fungal water transfer, reproduce a cited paper, or claim SOTA superiority.
composition_invariants: canonical root geometry and development remain owned by the existing plant structural authority
soil moisture, retention, hydraulic conductivity and soil-water flow remain owned by existing soil and hydrology authorities
plant hydraulic/stomatal models are adapters or independently qualified references, not duplicate root or soil solvers
fungal water transport is disabled unless a selected taxon-specific experiment supports the pathway and its matched controls
wound-induced poroelastic signalling is a separate validation profile and is not assumed to explain drought responses
pressure, mass flow, chemical elicitors, calcium signals, electrical potentials and tracer delivery are distinct observables
missing parameters and observations remain unknown; they are never silently replaced with zero or generic defaults
all coupling edges carry explicit units, spatial and temporal support, source identity, uncertainty and model revision

scientific_references.citation: OpenAlea.HydroRoot: a modelling framework to dissect, predict and phenotype branched root hydraulic architecture
scientific_references.role: root hydraulic and solute-transport comparator and interface reference
scientific_references.scope: static hydraulic solver, coupled water-solute transport, statistical root architecture generator and dynamic hydraulic model with root growth
known_limitations: The 2026 paper states that HydroRoot is soilless: soil is treated as a one-dimensional boundary condition and there is no explicit soil-root interaction.
Root segments are homogeneous single compartments; axial and radial conductances are parameterized by distance from the root tip as an age proxy.
The paper reports validation only on annual plants.

fair_comparison_rules: freeze source release code commit data checksum model configuration and parameter units
use the same initial conditions forcing interventions observation operators and held-out blocks
separate calibration and evaluation at the independent plant soil site or experimental-unit level
keep frames regions of interest hyphae and time points nested within their biological replicate
compare models at matched predictive error and uncertainty coverage rather than equal time step count
report parameter identifiability and confounding between soil supply and atmospheric demand
include no-path and matched-control cases to measure false causal attribution
report each process scale and worst stratum separately; do not hide failure in pooled averages
report capacitance and time-step values with units; distinguish numerical storage memory from biological acclimation or long-term stress memory
compare transient trajectories at common observation timestamps and verify time-step refinement before parameter fitting
HydroRoot root-side output must be coupled through an explicit soil boundary adapter; do not interpret its soilless boundary model as a soil-root interaction solver
respect source-specific software licenses; a public code/data record with missing license metadata is not automatically a grant to modify or redistribute
include paired cases with observationally equivalent measured states but different causal inputs; score correct abstention until a discriminating measurement is available
Buckley Eq 3a/3b comparison must use the paper's stated units, compatible leaf-area basis, source-specific A_m derivation and independent-plant/leaf holdouts
do not claim paper reproduction from the clean-room equation implementation; pin and rights-admit the Zenodo release and other source datasets before reproducing fitted values or reported figures
C3 A_m helper does not authorize use for C4 species; a separate source-faithful C4 profile is required
KPLANT calibration must group rows by source study and keep its five area/whole-plant normalization bases distinct
Dryad 2018 stomatal dataset must preserve source species/study and replicate or aggregate identity; do not use random row splits when repeated/aggregated observations share source groups

Liu 2026 physiology and 2024 half-hourly soil-water/radial-growth series have different years and sampling structures; never treat them as same-plant synchronized time series without an explicit source linkage
external data remain unadmitted until exact file version, checksum, rights and units are recorded in the #5816 data-admission workstream
